title: One Choice and Thirty Years
subtitle: 决策选择 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）
meta: 主题语境：决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）　|　核心词汇：consequence　|　正文 326 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 consequence 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 my grandfather ① accepted a consequence he had been told about eleven times, and he said the accepting was the whole of the choosing. The ② consequence, meaning the outcome and not the fault, arrived in the spring and stayed; consequence, he said, is the only thing in a choice that is judged by how early it was described.

Every ③ consequence in that family had the same shape, and the ④ consequence at the end, meaning the one he had not been told about and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever named twice. Consequence, my grandmother said, is nine parts describing and one part somebody willing to accept; my grandfather said the accepting is the part that fills the spring.

My mother meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ consequence was the whole of the meeting, meaning the importance and not the outcome. The ⑥ consequence, meaning the importance and not any of that, is the only thing in a meeting that everybody feels and nobody mentions; consequence, she said, is either something you accept or the only word that means both an outcome and an importance. He said the importance is the part they remember.

By 1971 the ⑦ consequence had become a line in a letter, and the letter had become an argument about the spring. The ⑧ consequence of the whole thing, my grandfather wrote in April, was one choice and thirty years of accepting; consequence, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to listen. She said the listening was never mentioned.

The ⑨ consequence I remember is the one at the end, which arrived in 1977 and is still described as the least described in the county. A ⑩ consequence, my grandmother said in 1979, is the only thing that improves by being accepted; every consequence, she said, is an importance that has agreed to look like an outcome. She said the importance was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 后果（指那个结果本身，与那份过错相对）
C. 固定搭配：accept a consequence 承担后果
D. n. 后果（指那个家族里每一次）
E. n. 后果（指末尾那一个）
F. n. 重要性；重大意义（of consequence 的用法）
G. n. 后果（指信里提到的那一个）
H. n. 影响；结局（抽象总称）

items.q: accepted a consequence he had been told about eleven times
The consequence, meaning the outcome and not the fault
consequence was the whole of the meeting
the consequence had become a line in a letter
The consequence of the whole thing
A consequence, my grandmother said in 1979

answers.why: accept a consequence 意为“承担后果”，1963 年祖父承担了一个被人提醒过十一次的后果。
consequence 意为“后果”，指那个结果本身而不是那份过错，它在春天到来，并且留了下来。
consequence 指那个家族里每一次后果，每一次都是同样的形状。
consequence 指末尾那一个（他从没被提醒过的那一个），是唯一有人点名过两次的。
consequence 意为“重要性、重大意义”，母亲说重要性就是那场会议的全部，指的是分量而不是那个结果。
consequence 为另一个义项，指那份重要性而不是那个结果，是会议里人人都感觉到、却无人提起的东西。
consequence 意为“后果”，指信里提到的那一个，到 1971 年这个后果成了信里的一行。
consequence 意为“影响、结局”，祖父四月写道，整件事的结局是一次选择三十年的承担。
consequence 意为“后果”，我记得的是末尾那一个，1977 年到来，至今仍被说成全县最没被描述过的。
consequence 为抽象总称，祖母说一个后果是唯一会因为被承担而变好的东西。
